parameters.name: NodeId
parameters.description:
The ID of the node.

> You can set this parameter to query the parameter settings of the specified node in a cluster instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~473763~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore describe-parameters --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --node-id r-bp1xxxxxxxxxxxxx-db-0 --region cn-hangzhou
